dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings are present against the dark dorsal pelage. A primary annulus in the upper mid-dorsal region shows a sharp gradient transition from dark exterior to a high-intensity white perimeter. A complex cluster of 3-4 interlocking light-colored annuli is located further posterior toward the tail.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, high-intensity white clusters located primarily in the mid-lateral section. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as dense, asymmetrical pixel groupings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct obtuse triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the primary upper-dorsal annulus and two adjacent smaller annuli. A cluster of four high-intensity blobs in the mid-lateral region forms a localized irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced red-eye retroreflection in the left ocular region and a series of high-contrast, concentric linear light-colored bands across the throat and lower neck.
